tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the Lium documentation for pages matching the query. Use for how-to questions (renting, SSH, templates, providing GPUs); for live GPU availability or prices use search_gpus or get_gpu_prices instead. Optionally filter by audience (providers, validators, pod-users, developers); without one, pa

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Return the raw Markdown source for a documentation page. Accepts a full URL, absolute slug (e.g. /providers/quickstart), or basename (e.g. quickstart). On tie among basenames, prefers pages in audience order: Providers > Validators > Renters > Developers.

tools.name: search_gpus
tools.description: List GPU nodes that can be rented on Lium right now, cheapest per GPU-hour first, with live USD prices and a rent link for each. Use when the user wants a specific machine (GPU model, count, country, price cap); use get_gpu_prices for a price overview. Each node has tier (secure or spot), reliabilit

tools.name: get_gpu_prices
tools.description: Live price range (min, median, max USD per GPU-hour) and free GPU count for each GPU model rentable on Lium right now. Use for "what does an H100 cost" or comparing models; use search_gpus to pick a node to rent. Pass count for multi-GPU quotes: a 1-GPU price can come from a node with one free GPU.

tools.name: estimate_provider_earnings
tools.description: Estimate what a provider earns per month on Lium by listing GPUs of a model, as the rewards calculator does: rental income (95% of the renter price) and rented extra at the last 30 days' utilisation, plus idle pay at the validator's rate for every unrented hour; with what those GPUs actually earned

tools.name: rent_pod
tools.description: Rent a GPU pod on Lium with your API key and wait until it runs; returns the pod id and the ssh command. Spends money from your Lium balance: the pod is billed per second until remove_pod, also when idle. Give gpu (and count, optional max_price_per_gpu_hour and country) to let Lium pick the cheapest

tools.name: list_pods
tools.description: Your Lium pods with status, ssh command and price per hour.

tools.name: get_pod
tools.description: One pod: status, ssh command (once RUNNING), price per hour and spend so far.

tools.name: remove_pod
tools.description: Request pod deletion. Billing stops when accepted; deletion may finish asynchronously (get_pod shows DELETING). Data on the pod is lost.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: Docker templates a pod can start from (official ones, your own and other users' public ones; official and yours mark which), for rent_pod template_id.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
